text:
nate: quick follow-up from the precision profiles RFC — I've sketched a lightweight runtime gateway + canary plan for FP8/INT8/4bit rollouts. want feedback on safety signals and the API knobs we expose.
claire: nice, tl;dr?
nate: idea = runtime 'precision gateway' that sits between request router and model backend. it negotiates an allowed precision set per-request (based on route, customer tier, prompt hints) and either forwards to optimized variant or triggers fallback.
maria: does that add a sync hop? latency concern.
nate: minimal — gateway is in-process for dedicated/private, gRPC microservice for hosted. we keep decisions cached + async refresh of profiles. typical path: check cache -> if miss evaluate fast heuristics (route config + prompt hash) -> return decision. median extra latency < 0.3ms in our perf sims.
tj: what heuristics? prompt length? tokens? user flags?
nate: yes: sequence length, model family, route SLO, user precision policy (explicit allowlist/denylist), and a small ML score for quality risk (computed offline per-profile). also stickiness if previous tokens used same kv-cache precision.
claire: i worry about quality regressions for sensitive prompts. how do we detect & rollback quickly?
maria: we should tie to eval holdouts and drift detection plus live signal like repeat-utterance rate and hallucination spikes.
nate: agreed. propose signals for automated rollback: 1) embed-sim drift > threshold on golden prompts; 2) increase in assistant-clarify prompts (users asking to re-run); 3) server-side quality metric spike (eval loss or BLEU delta); 4) sudden uptick in per-route error rate or timeout.
tj: can we implement a short-circuit safety policy? e.g. always run sensitive prompt patterns on higher precision.
maria: add a rule-engine that supports pattern rules and confidence thresholds. example rule: `if prompt matches /\bmedication|ssn|dob\b/i -> force precision >= INT8`
claire: we need to ship a simple config format for product to set per-route risk levels. don't make it a full DSL initially.
nate: agreed. proposal for config snippet (YAML):
```yaml
precision_policy:
  route: "/chat/compose"
  default: fp8
  overrides:
    - if_prompt_matches: "^summarize"
      min_precision: int8
    - customer_tier: enterprise
      allowed: [fp8, int8, int4]
    - safety_category: PHI
      min_precision: int8
```
claire: +1 for that shape. how about runtime telemetry? we need token-level cost delta and a quality-signal ID that links to eval sets.
tj: add a `precision_decision` tag to traces and sample payloads (prompt + output) for offline checks. also log `precision_shim_applied` boolean.
nate: good call. also the gateway should emit `decision_reason` (cache, rule, fallback, override) and if fallback was used, what fallback (e.g., downgraded quant -> CPU-checked).
maria: can we automate canary? steps I'd propose: 1) sample 0.1% traffic with candidate precision; 2) run offline evals + live sigs for 24h; 3) if no regression, ramp to 1% then 10% then 100%. each step gated by thresholds.
claire: thresholds? false positive tolerances?
maria: initial thresholds: embed-sim drop < 0.015, hallucination-related user-clarify increase < 1.5x, latency p95 increase < 10%. conservative but workable.
tj: ops playbook: accept, rollback, sticky-fallback. we should expose an emergency flag to force route->safe-precision and ship a small CLI.
nate: examples of decision payload for tracing (single-line JSON-ish):
```
{"route":"/chat/compose","precision":"fp8","decision_reason":"cache_hit","profile_version":"v3","approx_quality_score":"0.982"}
```
claire: who owns the rollout tool? eng-ml or infra?
maria: handoff: eng-ml owns model & profile logic, eng-infra owns gateway infra + rollout orchestration. product owns policy config surface.
tj: any API breaking changes? we should keep inference API same and make precision decisions orthogonal. only add optional header `x-precision-hint` for customers who want to force.
nate: yes keep API stable. also add telemetry header `x-precision-decision` in responses for enterprise debugging.
claire: security/compliance: ensure decision logs are PII-free and respect retention. tie to KMS/HSM for private deployments.
maria: testing: unit tests for rule-engine, integration tests with perf harness, and small-scale A/B with synthetic golden prompts.
ate: follow-ups: I'll open an RFC PR for the gateway interface and a canary runbook. action items: nate -> RFC PR by EOD, claire -> policy config draft, tj -> trace tags + CLI sketch, maria -> eval thresholds and sample sets.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: new branch detected for `precision-gateway-rfc`, CI jobs queued. :rocket:
claire: thanks, this helps. quick note — let's add a blacklist for cheap early-exit: if model returns known-bad token patterns with low logit gap, force re-run at higher precision.
maria: good pattern. we can add an estimator that looks at softmax temp / top2 gap.
tj: ok. i'll stub trace fields and add to telemetry schema. keep the config minimal for first pass.
nate: great, wrapping up. will drop the RFC link here once PR is up. :thumbsup:
